evidence_accounting_correction.rule: an observation timestamped at or after the exchange's recorded settlement_ts of its contract cannot be prospective pregame evidence (evidence-accounting correction, not a frozen-rule change)
evidence_accounting_correction.history: the earlier INCLUDED version of every corrected observation remains in the evidence file; the newer EXCLUDED version (same observation_id) is authoritative for scoring

frozen_definition.inclusion_rule: Singles match, ATP or WTA, with (a) a two-sided executable market quote on the match winner that de-vigs to a probability in [0.05, 0.95], (b) a Gen-2 state for both players, and (c) family EXACT_SET_SCORE. Best-of-3 and best-of-5 both admitted.
frozen_definition.required_accuracy_condition: mean exact-score log loss below the pure fundamental lane by >= 0.010 with a paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero
frozen_definition.required_clv_condition: not applicable to a pricing-accuracy claim; no CLV condition is asserted, and no trade may be justified by this candidate alone
frozen_definition.required_after_fee_condition: any trade derived from it must clear the Kalshi taker fee on every leg at the executable ask
